title: Each group counts a store's headcount once
question: What is the sales amount per employee by store state?
behavior: Both components reach store, so each branch groups by state. CA has sales of 325 (SS1, SS2, SS4) and 5 employees, NY has 90 (SS3, SS5) and 5. Over a join from store_sales to store, CA's headcount counts three times and gives 325 / 15. Appendix B.6.
